dwell_overview.label: Dwell Overview
dwell_overview.description: Fleet dwell-time analytics and SLA monitoring (scoped to the active region and vehicle).

data.query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT SESSION_ID) AS total_trips, ROUND(AVG(DWELL_MINUTES),1) AS avg_dwell, SUM(CASE WHEN DWELL_MINUTES <= 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)*1.0/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS sla_frac, COUNT(DISTINCT VEHICLE_ID) AS active_drivers FROM FLEET_APP.DWELL.VW_DWELL_SESSIONS WHERE (:date_range_start IS NULL OR SESSION_START >= :date_range_start::TIMESTAMP_NTZ) AND (:date_range_end IS NULL OR SESSION_START < DATEADD('day',1,:date_range_end::TIMESTAMP_NTZ))

SELECT SUBSTR(TO_VARCHAR(TREND_DATE),6) AS day, total_dwells, total_trips FROM ( SELECT TREND_DATE, TOTAL_SESSIONS AS total_dwells, ACTIVE_VEHICLES AS total_trips FROM FLEET_APP.DWELL.VW_DAILY_TRENDS ORDER BY TREND_DATE DESC LIMIT 30 ) ORDER BY day ASC
SELECT SUBSTR(LOCATION_NAME,1,20) AS facility_name, SUM(TOTAL_SESSIONS) AS total_visits FROM FLEET_APP.DWELL.VW_FACILITY_UTILIZATION GROUP BY LOCATION_NAME ORDER BY total_visits DESC LIMIT 10

dwell_congestion.label: Congestion Map
dwell_congestion.description: H3 dwell-density hexagons by hour of day (drag the slider to change the hour).

data.query: SELECT H3_CELL_R7 AS h3_index, SUM(SESSION_COUNT) AS dwell_count, ROUND(AVG(AVG_DWELL_MIN),1) AS avg_dwell_min FROM FLEET_APP.DWELL.VW_H3_CONGESTION WHERE EXTRACT(HOUR FROM HOUR_BUCKET) = TO_NUMBER(:selected_hour) AND (:date_range_start IS NULL OR HOUR_BUCKET >= :date_range_start::TIMESTAMP_NTZ) AND (:date_range_end IS NULL OR HOUR_BUCKET < DATEADD('day',1,:date_range_end::TIMESTAMP_NTZ)) GROUP BY H3_CELL_R7 LIMIT 5000

dwell_facilities.label: Facility Utilization
dwell_facilities.description: Dwell load by facility and facility type — where vehicles spend the most time.

data.query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT LOCATION_ID) AS facilities, SUM(TOTAL_SESSIONS) AS total_visits, ROUND(AVG(AVG_DWELL_MIN),1) AS avg_dwell, ROUND(MAX(MAX_DWELL_MIN),0) AS max_dwell FROM FLEET_APP.DWELL.VW_FACILITY_UTILIZATION
SELECT SUBSTR(LOCATION_NAME,1,22) AS facility_name, SUM(TOTAL_DWELL_MIN) AS dwell_min FROM FLEET_APP.DWELL.VW_FACILITY_UTILIZATION GROUP BY LOCATION_NAME ORDER BY dwell_min DESC LIMIT 12
SELECT COALESCE(FACILITY_TYPE,'unknown') AS facility_type, SUM(TOTAL_SESSIONS) AS visits FROM FLEET_APP.DWELL.VW_FACILITY_UTILIZATION GROUP BY FACILITY_TYPE ORDER BY visits DESC

dwell_drivers.label: Driver Performance
dwell_drivers.description: Per-driver dwell totals and SLA breaches — click a column header to sort.

data.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS drivers, SUM(SLA_BREACH_COUNT) AS sla_breaches, SUM(CRITICAL_BREACH_COUNT) AS critical_breaches, ROUND(AVG(AVG_SESSION_MIN),1) AS avg_session FROM FLEET_APP.DWELL.VW_DRIVER_DWELL_SUMMARY
SELECT VEHICLE_ID AS driver, SLA_BREACH_COUNT AS breaches FROM FLEET_APP.DWELL.VW_DRIVER_DWELL_SUMMARY ORDER BY breaches DESC LIMIT 12

SELECT VEHICLE_ID AS driver, DRIVER_PROFILE AS profile, HOME_BASE_NAME AS home_base, TOTAL_DWELL_HOURS AS dwell_hours, SLA_BREACH_COUNT AS sla_breaches, CRITICAL_BREACH_COUNT AS critical FROM FLEET_APP.DWELL.VW_DRIVER_DWELL_SUMMARY ORDER BY sla_breaches DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT VEHICLE_ID AS vehicle_id, ST_X(POINT_GEOM) AS lng, ST_Y(POINT_GEOM) AS lat, STATUS AS state, ROUND(SPEED_KMH,0) AS speed_kmh FROM FLEET_APP.DWELL.VW_VEHICLE_TELEMETRY WHERE :selected_driver IS NOT NULL AND VEHICLE_ID = :selected_driver AND POINT_GEOM IS NOT NULL AND (:date_range_start IS NULL OR TS >= :date_range_start::TIMESTAMP_NTZ) AND (:date_range_end IS NULL OR TS < DATEADD('day',1,:date_range_end::TIMESTAMP_NTZ)) ORDER BY TS LIMIT 5000

dwell_sla.label: SLA Alerts
dwell_sla.description: Dwell sessions that breached SLA thresholds, by severity.

data.query: SELECT DISTINCT SLA_STATUS AS value, SLA_STATUS AS label FROM FLEET_APP.DWELL.VW_SLA_ALERTS WHERE SLA_STATUS IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS alerts, SUM(IFF(SLA_STATUS='CRITICAL',1,0)) AS critical, SUM(IFF(SLA_STATUS='WARNING',1,0)) AS warning, ROUND(AVG(MINUTES_OVER_WARNING),1) AS avg_over FROM FLEET_APP.DWELL.VW_SLA_ALERTS WHERE (:date_range_start IS NULL OR SESSION_START >= :date_range_start::TIMESTAMP_NTZ) AND (:date_range_end IS NULL OR SESSION_START < DATEADD('day',1,:date_range_end::TIMESTAMP_NTZ))

SELECT SLA_STATUS AS status, COUNT(*) AS alerts FROM FLEET_APP.DWELL.VW_SLA_ALERTS WHERE (:date_range_start IS NULL OR SESSION_START >= :date_range_start::TIMESTAMP_NTZ) AND (:date_range_end IS NULL OR SESSION_START < DATEADD('day',1,:date_range_end::TIMESTAMP_NTZ)) GROUP BY SLA_STATUS ORDER BY alerts DESC

SELECT VEHICLE_ID AS driver, SUBSTR(LOCATION_NAME,1,24) AS location, SLA_STATUS AS status, ROUND(DWELL_MINUTES,0) AS dwell_min, ROUND(MINUTES_OVER_WARNING,0) AS over_warning FROM FLEET_APP.DWELL.VW_SLA_ALERTS WHERE (:selected_severity IS NULL OR SLA_STATUS = :selected_severity) AND (:date_range_start IS NULL OR SESSION_START >= :date_range_start::TIMESTAMP_NTZ) AND (:date_range_end IS NULL OR SESSION_START < DATEADD('day',1,:date_range_end::TIMESTAMP_NTZ)) ORDER BY MINUTES_OVER_WARNING DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 100

SELECT LOCATION_NAME AS name, ST_X(AVG_POINT) AS lng, ST_Y(AVG_POINT) AS lat, ROUND(DWELL_MINUTES,0) AS dwell_min, SLA_STATUS AS sla FROM FLEET_APP.DWELL.VW_SLA_ALERTS WHERE :selected_driver IS NOT NULL AND VEHICLE_ID = :selected_driver AND AVG_POINT IS NOT NULL AND (:date_range_start IS NULL OR SESSION_START >= :date_range_start::TIMESTAMP_NTZ) AND (:date_range_end IS NULL OR SESSION_START < DATEADD('day',1,:date_range_end::TIMESTAMP_NTZ)) ORDER BY SESSION_START LIMIT 5000

deviation_overview.label: Route Deviation
deviation_overview.description: Planned vs actual route adherence — daily trend and worst drivers.

data.query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT TRIP_ID) AS total_trips, SUM(IFF(IS_ROUTE_DEVIATION,1,0)) AS deviation_trips, SUM(IFF(IS_ROUTE_DEVIATION,1,0))*1.0/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS deviation_frac, ROUND(SUM(DISTANCE_DEVIATION_KM),0) AS excess_km FROM FLEET_APP.ROUTE_DEVIATION.VW_TRIP_DEVIATION WHERE (:date_range_start IS NULL OR TRIP_DATE >= :date_range_start::DATE) AND (:date_range_end IS NULL OR TRIP_DATE <= :date_range_end::DATE)
SELECT TO_VARCHAR(TRIP_DATE) AS day, DEVIATION_RATE_PCT AS deviation_rate, TOTAL_TRIPS AS trips FROM FLEET_APP.ROUTE_DEVIATION.VW_DAILY_DEVIATION_TRENDS ORDER BY TRIP_DATE
SELECT DRIVER_ID AS driver, DEVIATION_RATE_PCT AS deviation_rate FROM FLEET_APP.ROUTE_DEVIATION.VW_DRIVER_DEVIATION_SUMMARY ORDER BY deviation_rate DESC LIMIT 12

deviation_routes.label: Route Comparison
deviation_routes.description: Actual (red) vs expected (blue) driven paths for the most-deviating trips.

data.query: SELECT TRIP_ID AS trip_id, ST_ASGEOJSON(EXPECTED_PATH)::STRING AS expected_geojson FROM FLEET_APP.ROUTE_DEVIATION.VW_TRIP_DEVIATION WHERE EXPECTED_PATH IS NOT NULL AND IS_ROUTE_DEVIATION AND (:selected_trip IS NULL OR TRIP_ID = :selected_trip) AND (:date_range_start IS NULL OR TRIP_DATE >= :date_range_start::DATE) AND (:date_range_end IS NULL OR TRIP_DATE <= :date_range_end::DATE) ORDER BY DISTANCE_DEVIATION_PCT DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT TRIP_ID AS trip_id, ST_ASGEOJSON(ACTUAL_PATH)::STRING AS actual_geojson FROM FLEET_APP.ROUTE_DEVIATION.VW_TRIP_DEVIATION WHERE ACTUAL_PATH IS NOT NULL AND IS_ROUTE_DEVIATION AND (:selected_trip IS NULL OR TRIP_ID = :selected_trip) AND (:date_range_start IS NULL OR TRIP_DATE >= :date_range_start::DATE) AND (:date_range_end IS NULL OR TRIP_DATE <= :date_range_end::DATE) ORDER BY DISTANCE_DEVIATION_PCT DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT TRIP_ID AS trip_id, DRIVER_ID AS driver, SUBSTR(ORIGIN_NAME,1,18) AS origin, SUBSTR(DEST_NAME,1,18) AS destination, ROUND(DISTANCE_DEVIATION_PCT,1) AS dev_pct, ROUND(DISTANCE_DEVIATION_KM,1) AS excess_km FROM FLEET_APP.ROUTE_DEVIATION.VW_TRIP_DEVIATION WHERE IS_ROUTE_DEVIATION AND (:date_range_start IS NULL OR TRIP_DATE >= :date_range_start::DATE) AND (:date_range_end IS NULL OR TRIP_DATE <= :date_range_end::DATE) ORDER BY DISTANCE_DEVIATION_PCT DESC LIMIT 20

fleetops_status.label: Fleet Status
fleetops_status.description: Asset activity, distance, and safety events for the active fleet (any vehicle mode).

data.query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT TRIP_ID) AS total_trips, COUNT(DISTINCT OPERATOR_ID) AS operators, ROUND(AVG(DISTANCE_KM),1) AS avg_dist_km, SUM(IFF(IS_DETOUR,1,0)) AS detours FROM TABLE(FLEET_APP.FLEET_OPS.F_VW_TRIPS_SCOPED(CAST(:region AS VARCHAR), CAST(:dataset_id AS VARCHAR))) WHERE (:date_range_start IS NULL OR TRIP_START >= :date_range_start::TIMESTAMP_NTZ) AND (:date_range_end IS NULL OR TRIP_START < DATEADD('day',1,:date_range_end::TIMESTAMP_NTZ))

SELECT COUNT(*) AS pings, SUM(IFF(IS_SPEEDING,1,0)) AS speeding, SUM(IFF(IS_HOS_VIOLATION,1,0)) AS hos, ROUND(AVG(SPEED_KMH),1) AS avg_speed FROM TABLE(FLEET_APP.FLEET_OPS.F_VW_TELEMETRY_SCOPED(CAST(:region AS VARCHAR), CAST(:dataset_id AS VARCHAR))) WHERE (:date_range_start IS NULL OR TS >= :date_range_start::TIMESTAMP_NTZ) AND (:date_range_end IS NULL OR TS < DATEADD('day',1,:date_range_end::TIMESTAMP_NTZ))

SELECT REGION AS region, COUNT(*) AS trips FROM TABLE(FLEET_APP.FLEET_OPS.F_VW_TRIPS_SCOPED(CAST(:region AS VARCHAR), CAST(:dataset_id AS VARCHAR))) WHERE (:date_range_start IS NULL OR TRIP_START >= :date_range_start::TIMESTAMP_NTZ) AND (:date_range_end IS NULL OR TRIP_START < DATEADD('day',1,:date_range_end::TIMESTAMP_NTZ)) GROUP BY REGION ORDER BY trips DESC

SELECT COALESCE(STATUS,'unknown') AS status, COUNT(*) AS trips FROM TABLE(FLEET_APP.FLEET_OPS.F_VW_TRIPS_SCOPED(CAST(:region AS VARCHAR), CAST(:dataset_id AS VARCHAR))) WHERE (:date_range_start IS NULL OR TRIP_START >= :date_range_start::TIMESTAMP_NTZ) AND (:date_range_end IS NULL OR TRIP_START < DATEADD('day',1,:date_range_end::TIMESTAMP_NTZ)) GROUP BY STATUS ORDER BY trips DESC

SELECT TRIP_ID AS trip_id, ST_ASGEOJSON(GEOMETRY)::STRING AS route_geojson FROM TABLE(FLEET_APP.FLEET_OPS.F_VW_TRIP_SUMMARY_SCOPED(CAST(:region AS VARCHAR), CAST(:dataset_id AS VARCHAR))) WHERE GEOMETRY IS NOT NULL AND (:date_range_start IS NULL OR TRIP_START_TIME >= :date_range_start::TIMESTAMP_NTZ) AND (:date_range_end IS NULL OR TRIP_START_TIME < DATEADD('day',1,:date_range_end::TIMESTAMP_NTZ)) ORDER BY ROUTE_DISTANCE_METERS DESC LIMIT 100

fleetops_map.label: Asset Map
fleetops_map.description: Live asset telemetry positions — click an operator to highlight its pings.

data.query: SELECT OPERATOR_ID AS operator_id, COUNT(*) AS pings, SUM(IFF(IS_SPEEDING,1,0)) AS speeding FROM TABLE(FLEET_APP.FLEET_OPS.F_VW_TELEMETRY_SCOPED(CAST(:region AS VARCHAR), CAST(:dataset_id AS VARCHAR))) WHERE (:date_range_start IS NULL OR TS >= :date_range_start::TIMESTAMP_NTZ) AND (:date_range_end IS NULL OR TS < DATEADD('day',1,:date_range_end::TIMESTAMP_NTZ)) GROUP BY OPERATOR_ID ORDER BY pings DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT OPERATOR_ID AS operator_id, LONGITUDE AS lng, LATITUDE AS lat, ROUND(SPEED_KMH,0) AS speed_kmh FROM (SELECT OPERATOR_ID, LONGITUDE, LATITUDE, SPEED_KMH FROM TABLE(FLEET_APP.FLEET_OPS.F_VW_TELEMETRY_SCOPED(CAST(:region AS VARCHAR), CAST(:dataset_id AS VARCHAR))) WHERE LATITUDE IS NOT NULL AND (:date_range_start IS NULL OR TS >= :date_range_start::TIMESTAMP_NTZ) AND (:date_range_end IS NULL OR TS < DATEADD('day',1,:date_range_end::TIMESTAMP_NTZ))) SAMPLE (5000 ROWS)

fleetops_density.label: Demand Density
fleetops_density.description: H3 hexbin of GPS activity by hour of day (pick a metric, drag the slider to change the hour).

data.query: SELECT 'pings' AS value, 'Activity (pings)' AS label UNION ALL SELECT 'speed','Avg Speed (km/h)'

SELECT H3_INDEX AS h3_index, SUM(PING_COUNT) AS ping_count, ROUND(AVG(AVG_SPEED_KMH),1) AS avg_speed, CASE WHEN :selected_metric = 'speed' THEN ROUND(AVG(AVG_SPEED_KMH),1) ELSE SUM(PING_COUNT) END AS metric_value FROM TABLE(FLEET_APP.FLEET_OPS.F_VW_H3_DENSITY_SCOPED(CAST(:region AS VARCHAR), CAST(:dataset_id AS VARCHAR), CAST(:selected_hour AS NUMBER))) GROUP BY H3_INDEX LIMIT 5000

fleetops_trips.label: Trip Inspection
fleetops_trips.description: Driven trip paths (longest trips shown) with per-trip distance, duration, and speed.

data.query: SELECT TRIP_ID AS trip_id, ST_ASGEOJSON(GEOMETRY)::STRING AS route_geojson FROM TABLE(FLEET_APP.FLEET_OPS.F_VW_TRIP_SUMMARY_SCOPED(CAST(:region AS VARCHAR), CAST(:dataset_id AS VARCHAR))) WHERE GEOMETRY IS NOT NULL AND (:selected_trip IS NULL OR TRIP_ID = :selected_trip) AND (:date_range_start IS NULL OR TRIP_START_TIME >= :date_range_start::TIMESTAMP_NTZ) AND (:date_range_end IS NULL OR TRIP_START_TIME < DATEADD('day',1,:date_range_end::TIMESTAMP_NTZ)) ORDER BY ROUTE_DISTANCE_METERS DESC LIMIT 60

SELECT TRIP_ID AS trip_id, OPERATOR_ID AS operator, SUBSTR(ORIGIN_ADDRESS,1,22) AS origin, SUBSTR(DESTINATION_ADDRESS,1,22) AS destination, ROUND(ROUTE_DISTANCE_METERS/1000,1) AS dist_km, ROUND(ROUTE_DURATION_SECS/60,1) AS dur_min, ROUND(AVERAGE_KMH,1) AS avg_kmh FROM TABLE(FLEET_APP.FLEET_OPS.F_VW_TRIP_SUMMARY_SCOPED(CAST(:region AS VARCHAR), CAST(:dataset_id AS VARCHAR))) WHERE GEOMETRY IS NOT NULL AND (:date_range_start IS NULL OR TRIP_START_TIME >= :date_range_start::TIMESTAMP_NTZ) AND (:date_range_end IS NULL OR TRIP_START_TIME < DATEADD('day',1,:date_range_end::TIMESTAMP_NTZ)) ORDER BY ROUTE_DISTANCE_METERS DESC LIMIT 60

fleetops_operators.label: Operator Performance
fleetops_operators.description: Per-operator productivity — click an operator to map its trips.

data.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS operators, SUM(TRIPS) AS total_trips, ROUND(AVG(AVG_SPEED_KMH),1) AS avg_speed, ROUND(AVG(AVG_DISTANCE_KM),2) AS avg_dist FROM TABLE(FLEET_APP.FLEET_OPS.F_VW_OPERATOR_PERF_SCOPED(CAST(:region AS VARCHAR), CAST(:dataset_id AS VARCHAR)))
SELECT OPERATOR_ID AS operator, TRIPS AS trips FROM TABLE(FLEET_APP.FLEET_OPS.F_VW_OPERATOR_PERF_SCOPED(CAST(:region AS VARCHAR), CAST(:dataset_id AS VARCHAR))) ORDER BY trips DESC LIMIT 12

SELECT OPERATOR_ID AS operator, COALESCE(SHIFT_TYPE,'-') AS shift, COALESCE(DRIVER_PROFILE,'-') AS profile, TRIPS AS trips, TOTAL_DISTANCE_KM AS total_km, AVG_SPEED_KMH AS avg_kmh FROM TABLE(FLEET_APP.FLEET_OPS.F_VW_OPERATOR_PERF_SCOPED(CAST(:region AS VARCHAR), CAST(:dataset_id AS VARCHAR))) ORDER BY trips DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT TRIP_ID AS trip_id, ST_ASGEOJSON(GEOMETRY)::STRING AS route_geojson FROM TABLE(FLEET_APP.FLEET_OPS.F_VW_TRIP_SUMMARY_SCOPED(CAST(:region AS VARCHAR), CAST(:dataset_id AS VARCHAR))) WHERE GEOMETRY IS NOT NULL AND (:selected_operator IS NULL OR OPERATOR_ID = :selected_operator) ORDER BY ROUTE_DISTANCE_METERS DESC LIMIT 200

fleetops_origins.label: Top Origins
fleetops_origins.description: Busiest origin locations by trip volume — where journeys begin (any origin type).

data.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS origins, SUM(TOTAL_TRIPS) AS trips, ROUND(AVG(AVG_DURATION_MIN),1) AS avg_dur, COUNT(DISTINCT LOCATION_TYPE) AS types FROM TABLE(FLEET_APP.FLEET_OPS.F_VW_TOP_ORIGINS_SCOPED(CAST(:region AS VARCHAR), CAST(:dataset_id AS VARCHAR), CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR)))

SELECT SUBSTR(ORIGIN_NAME,1,22) AS origin, TOTAL_TRIPS AS trips FROM TABLE(FLEET_APP.FLEET_OPS.F_VW_TOP_ORIGINS_SCOPED(CAST(:region AS VARCHAR), CAST(:dataset_id AS VARCHAR), CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR))) WHERE TOTAL_TRIPS > 0 ORDER BY trips DESC LIMIT 12

SELECT ORIGIN_NAME AS poi_name, LOCATION_TYPE AS category, LNG AS lng, LAT AS lat, TOTAL_TRIPS AS trips FROM TABLE(FLEET_APP.FLEET_OPS.F_VW_TOP_ORIGINS_SCOPED(CAST(:region AS VARCHAR), CAST(:dataset_id AS VARCHAR), CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR))) WHERE LAT IS NOT NULL AND TOTAL_TRIPS > 0 ORDER BY trips DESC LIMIT 2000

retail_catchment.label: Retail Catchment
retail_catchment.description: Retail points of interest — filter by category, click a POI to highlight it and its nearby competitors.

data.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS pois, COUNT(DISTINCT BASIC_CATEGORY) AS categories, COUNT(DISTINCT CITY) AS cities, COUNT(DISTINCT STATE) AS states FROM FLEET_APP.RETAIL_CATCHMENT.VW_RETAIL_POIS
SELECT BASIC_CATEGORY AS value, BASIC_CATEGORY AS label FROM FLEET_APP.RETAIL_CATCHMENT.VW_RETAIL_POIS WHERE BASIC_CATEGORY IS NOT NULL GROUP BY BASIC_CATEGORY ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 30

SELECT POI_NAME AS poi_name, BASIC_CATEGORY AS category FROM FLEET_APP.RETAIL_CATCHMENT.VW_RETAIL_POIS WHERE LATITUDE IS NOT NULL AND (:selected_category IS NULL OR BASIC_CATEGORY = :selected_category) ORDER BY POI_NAME LIMIT 500

SELECT H3_POINT_TO_CELL_STRING(GEOMETRY, 8) AS h3_index, COUNT(*) AS addr FROM FLEET_APP.RETAIL_CATCHMENT.VW_REGIONAL_ADDRESSES WHERE GEOMETRY IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(:show_density,'false') = 'true' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY addr DESC LIMIT 5000

SELECT r.POI_NAME AS poi_name, r.BASIC_CATEGORY AS category, r.LONGITUDE AS lng, r.LATITUDE AS lat FROM FLEET_APP.RETAIL_CATCHMENT.VW_RETAIL_POIS r WHERE :selected_poi IS NOT NULL AND r.POI_NAME <> :selected_poi AND r.LATITUDE IS NOT NULL AND ST_DWITHIN(ST_MAKEPOINT(r.LONGITUDE, r.LATITUDE), (SELECT ST_MAKEPOINT(LONGITUDE, LATITUDE) FROM FLEET_APP.RETAIL_CATCHMENT.VW_RETAIL_POIS WHERE POI_NAME = :selected_poi LIMIT 1), 2000) LIMIT 500

SELECT POI_NAME AS poi_name, BASIC_CATEGORY AS category, LONGITUDE AS lng, LATITUDE AS lat FROM FLEET_APP.RETAIL_CATCHMENT.VW_RETAIL_POIS WHERE LATITUDE IS NOT NULL AND LONGITUDE IS NOT NULL AND (:selected_category IS NULL OR BASIC_CATEGORY = :selected_category) LIMIT 5000

asset_velocity.label: Asset Velocity
asset_velocity.description: Idle trailers, cost of idleness, and where they are parked — set a minimum idle and click a trailer to highlight it.

data.query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT VEHICLE_ID) AS idle_trailers, ROUND(SUM(COST_OF_IDLENESS_USD),0) AS cost_usd, ROUND(SUM(PROJECTED_SAVINGS_USD),0) AS savings_usd, ROUND(AVG(IDLE_DAYS),1) AS avg_idle_days FROM FLEET_APP.ROUTE_OPTIMIZATION.VW_TRAILER_COST_OF_IDLENESS WHERE (:idle_min IS NULL OR IDLE_MINUTES >= :idle_min) AND (:date_range_start IS NULL OR IDLE_SINCE >= :date_range_start::TIMESTAMP_NTZ) AND (:date_range_end IS NULL OR IDLE_SINCE < DATEADD('day',1,:date_range_end::TIMESTAMP_NTZ))

SELECT IDLE_SEVERITY AS severity, COUNT(*) AS trailers FROM FLEET_APP.ROUTE_OPTIMIZATION.VW_TRAILER_COST_OF_IDLENESS WHERE (:idle_min IS NULL OR IDLE_MINUTES >= :idle_min) AND (:date_range_start IS NULL OR IDLE_SINCE >= :date_range_start::TIMESTAMP_NTZ) AND (:date_range_end IS NULL OR IDLE_SINCE < DATEADD('day',1,:date_range_end::TIMESTAMP_NTZ)) GROUP BY IDLE_SEVERITY ORDER BY trailers DESC

SELECT TERMINAL_NAME AS terminal_name, DEMAND_SCORE AS demand_score, TERMINAL_LNG AS lng, TERMINAL_LAT AS lat FROM FLEET_APP.ROUTE_OPTIMIZATION.VW_LANE_DEMAND WHERE TERMINAL_LAT IS NOT NULL ORDER BY DEMAND_SCORE DESC LIMIT 500

SELECT VEHICLE_ID AS vehicle_id, IDLE_SEVERITY AS severity, IDLE_DAYS AS idle_days, LAST_LNG AS lng, LAST_LAT AS lat FROM FLEET_APP.ROUTE_OPTIMIZATION.VW_TRAILER_COST_OF_IDLENESS WHERE LAST_LAT IS NOT NULL AND LAST_LNG IS NOT NULL AND (:idle_min IS NULL OR IDLE_MINUTES >= :idle_min) AND (:date_range_start IS NULL OR IDLE_SINCE >= :date_range_start::TIMESTAMP_NTZ) AND (:date_range_end IS NULL OR IDLE_SINCE < DATEADD('day',1,:date_range_end::TIMESTAMP_NTZ)) LIMIT 2000

SELECT VEHICLE_ID AS vehicle_id, VEHICLE_SUBTYPE AS subtype, SUBSTR(LAST_LOCATION_NAME,1,24) AS last_location, ROUND(IDLE_DAYS,1) AS idle_days, IDLE_SEVERITY AS severity, ASSIGNED_DISPATCHER AS dispatcher, ROUND(COST_OF_IDLENESS_USD,0) AS cost_usd FROM FLEET_APP.ROUTE_OPTIMIZATION.VW_TRAILER_COST_OF_IDLENESS WHERE (:idle_min IS NULL OR IDLE_MINUTES >= :idle_min) AND (:date_range_start IS NULL OR IDLE_SINCE >= :date_range_start::TIMESTAMP_NTZ) AND (:date_range_end IS NULL OR IDLE_SINCE < DATEADD('day',1,:date_range_end::TIMESTAMP_NTZ)) ORDER BY COST_OF_IDLENESS_USD DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 200

SELECT SNOWFLAKE.CORTEX.COMPLETE('llama3.1-8b', 'You are a fleet dispatcher. In 2 sentences recommend a concrete repositioning action for idle trailer ' || VEHICLE_ID || ' (' || COALESCE(VEHICLE_SUBTYPE,'trailer') || ') idle ' || ROUND(IDLE_DAYS,1) || ' days at ' || LAST_LOCATION_NAME || ', idleness cost $' || ROUND(COST_OF_IDLENESS_USD,0) || '.') AS ai_rationale FROM FLEET_APP.ROUTE_OPTIMIZATION.VW_TRAILER_COST_OF_IDLENESS WHERE VEHICLE_ID = :selected_trailer

dwell_trips.label: Trip Inspector
dwell_trips.description: Per-trip GPS path and dwell stops — click a trip to inspect its stops on the map.

data.query: SELECT TRIP_ID AS trip_id, ANY_VALUE(VEHICLE_ID) AS vehicle, COUNT(*) AS dwells, ROUND(SUM(DWELL_MINUTES),0) AS dwell_min FROM FLEET_APP.DWELL.VW_DWELL_SESSIONS WHERE TRIP_ID IS NOT NULL AND (:date_range_start IS NULL OR SESSION_START >= :date_range_start::TIMESTAMP_NTZ) AND (:date_range_end IS NULL OR SESSION_START < DATEADD('day',1,:date_range_end::TIMESTAMP_NTZ)) GROUP BY TRIP_ID ORDER BY dwell_min DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 100

SELECT TRIP_ID AS trip_id, ST_ASGEOJSON(TO_GEOGRAPHY('LINESTRING(' || LISTAGG(ST_X(POINT_GEOM) || ' ' || ST_Y(POINT_GEOM), ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY TS) || ')'))::STRING AS route_geojson FROM FLEET_APP.DWELL.VW_VEHICLE_TELEMETRY WHERE TRIP_ID = :selected_trip AND POINT_GEOM IS NOT NULL GROUP BY TRIP_ID HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2

SELECT s.LOCATION_NAME AS name, ST_X(s.AVG_POINT) AS lng, ST_Y(s.AVG_POINT) AS lat, ROUND(s.DWELL_MINUTES,0) AS dwell_min, COALESCE(a.SLA_STATUS,'OK') AS sla FROM FLEET_APP.DWELL.VW_DWELL_SESSIONS s LEFT JOIN FLEET_APP.DWELL.VW_SLA_ALERTS a ON s.VEHICLE_ID = a.VEHICLE_ID AND s.SESSION_ID = a.SESSION_ID WHERE s.TRIP_ID = :selected_trip AND s.AVG_POINT IS NOT NULL

dwell_live.label: Live Operations
dwell_live.description: Last-known asset positions by state, with the most recent dwell sessions.

data.query: SELECT VEHICLE_ID AS vehicle_id, ST_X(POINT_GEOM) AS lng, ST_Y(POINT_GEOM) AS lat, STATUS AS state FROM FLEET_APP.DWELL.VW_VEHICLE_TELEMETRY WHERE POINT_GEOM IS NOT NULL AND (:date_range_start IS NULL OR TS >= :date_range_start::TIMESTAMP_NTZ) AND (:date_range_end IS NULL OR TS < DATEADD('day',1,:date_range_end::TIMESTAMP_NTZ)) QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY VEHICLE_ID ORDER BY TS DESC) = 1

SELECT VEHICLE_ID AS vehicle, SUBSTR(LOCATION_NAME,1,24) AS location, STATUS AS state, ROUND(DWELL_MINUTES,0) AS dwell_min, TO_VARCHAR(SESSION_END) AS last_seen FROM FLEET_APP.DWELL.VW_DWELL_SESSIONS WHERE (:date_range_start IS NULL OR SESSION_END >= :date_range_start::TIMESTAMP_NTZ) AND (:date_range_end IS NULL OR SESSION_END < DATEADD('day',1,:date_range_end::TIMESTAMP_NTZ)) ORDER BY SESSION_END DESC LIMIT 100

deviation_inspector.label: Route Inspector
deviation_inspector.description: Per-trip GPS trace with teleport/detour points, accuracy filter, and speed profile.

default.grid:
"vehsel tripsel maxacc"
"tele detour ."
"metrics metrics metrics"
"map map map"
"speed speed speed"

data.query: SELECT DISTINCT VEHICLE_ID AS value, VEHICLE_ID AS label FROM FLEET_APP.ROUTE_DEVIATION.VW_TRIP_GPS_POINTS ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 200
SELECT DISTINCT TRIP_ID AS value, TRIP_ID AS label FROM FLEET_APP.ROUTE_DEVIATION.VW_TRIP_GPS_POINTS WHERE (:selected_vehicle IS NULL OR VEHICLE_ID = :selected_vehicle) ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 200

SELECT COUNT(*) AS points, SUM(IFF(IS_TELEPORT,1,0)) AS teleports, SUM(IFF(IS_DETOUR,1,0)) AS detours, ROUND(AVG(SPEED_KMH),1) AS avg_speed FROM FLEET_APP.ROUTE_DEVIATION.VW_TRIP_GPS_POINTS WHERE TRIP_ID = :selected_trip

SELECT TRIP_ID, ST_ASGEOJSON(TO_GEOGRAPHY('LINESTRING(' || LISTAGG(LNG || ' ' || LAT, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY POINT_INDEX) || ')'))::STRING AS route_geojson FROM FLEET_APP.ROUTE_DEVIATION.VW_TRIP_GPS_POINTS WHERE TRIP_ID = :selected_trip AND (:max_acc IS NULL OR GPS_ACCURACY_M <= :max_acc) GROUP BY TRIP_ID HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2

SELECT POINT_INDEX AS point_index, LNG AS lng, LAT AS lat, ROUND(SPEED_KMH,0) AS speed_kmh, ROUND(GPS_ACCURACY_M,0) AS gps_accuracy_m, CASE WHEN IS_TELEPORT THEN 'teleport' WHEN IS_DETOUR THEN 'detour' ELSE 'normal' END AS point_kind FROM FLEET_APP.ROUTE_DEVIATION.VW_TRIP_GPS_POINTS WHERE TRIP_ID = :selected_trip AND (:max_acc IS NULL OR GPS_ACCURACY_M <= :max_acc) AND (CASE WHEN IS_TELEPORT THEN COALESCE(:show_teleports,'true') WHEN IS_DETOUR THEN COALESCE(:show_detours,'true') ELSE 'true' END = 'true') ORDER BY POINT_INDEX LIMIT 5000
SELECT POINT_INDEX AS idx, SPEED_KMH AS speed FROM FLEET_APP.ROUTE_DEVIATION.VW_TRIP_GPS_POINTS WHERE TRIP_ID = :selected_trip ORDER BY POINT_INDEX LIMIT 2000
